item.title: Art Futures Camp 2026 – Diriyah Art Futures
item.description: Art Futures Summer Camp for Arabic-Speaking Teens is a three-week immersive programme hosted by Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), the MENA region’s first centre dedicated to New Media Arts. Designed for Arabic-speaking teens aged 14–18, the camp offers an in-depth introduction to digital art practices in a dynamic and supportive environment. Under the 2026 theme, “Digital Art and Portraiture,” participants explore new ways of representing identity in the digital age, questioning how individuals are portrayed when faces become data and images circulate beyond physical presence. The programme combines creative experimentation with foundational technical skills, including Fab Lab practices and digital studio portraiture. Throughout the camp, participants work closely with industry specialists and creative mentors, culminating in a collaborative exhibition produced with DAF’s curatorial and exhibition teams to showcase their work. Applications are officially open, with aspiring young creatives in Riyadh able to apply until Sunday, June 7.

item.title: Mishkat Summer Camp
item.description: Discover the exciting world of science, energy, and innovation at Mishkat Summer Camp 2026, where young learners can explore the future through hands-on experiments, interactive challenges, educational games, and collaborative activities designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and teamwork. Organised by Mishkat Interactive Center, an initiative of the King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (K.A.CARE), the camp introduces participants to the future of energy while developing STEAM skills through experiential learning. Activities explore topics such as solar, wind, and nuclear energy, hydrogen technologies, the circular carbon economy, artificial intelligence, innovation, and programming, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goals of building future-ready generations. The programme is free of charge and is open to children aged 10–12 years. Camp Schedule Girls: 12–23 July | Boys: 26 July–6 August | Days: Sunday–Thursday Register Now

item.title: SAIF Summer Program
item.description: SAIF 2026 is a summer creative program presented by SAMoCA at JAX, offering a diverse range of workshops, film screenings, and interactive activities for children, teenagers, and young audiences. The program features hands-on experiences in ceramics, fashion and tailoring, papermaking, photography, writing, voiceover, and other creative disciplines. Developed in collaboration with cultural and educational partners, SAIF encourages artistic expression, creativity, and cultural discovery through engaging learning experiences. Hosted at SAMoCA at JAX in the JAX District, Diriyah, the program provides an inspiring environment where visitors can explore Saudi creativity, develop new skills, and participate in a vibrant community of art and culture.

item.title: Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program
item.description: Introduce your children to the richness of Saudi Arabia's traditional arts at the Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program 2026, organized by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts (Wrth). Taking place at Riyadh Park from 16 to 18 July 2026, the program offers children aged 8–12 an enriching summer experience through a sensory, hands-on journey exploring the traditional arts of the Kingdom's diverse regions. Through a variety of interactive activity stations, children will discover heritage-inspired crafts including pottery, Al Sadu weaving, traditional incense burner (mabkharah) making, Najdi door decoration, and other traditional art forms. Designed to nurture creativity, develop practical skills, and deepen appreciation for Saudi culture, the program provides an engaging environment where young learners can explore, create, and connect with the Kingdom's rich artistic heritage. item.title: Saudi Light and Sound (SLS) Expo
item.description: Discover the future of Saudi Arabia’s professional light and sound industry at the Saudi Light & Sound (SLS) Exhibition, the premier platform for event technology, lighting design, and audio innovations. The exhibition offers a rare opportunity to present AV and lighting solutions at the heart of a fast-evolving market, with the Pro AV segment valued at $30.5 million in 2024 and projected to reach $40.5 million by 2033, fueled by smart city investments and immersive event infrastructure. Visitors can connect with decision-makers driving billion-dollar projects, explore cutting-edge solutions across pro lighting, audio equipment, stage technology, digital signage, laser effects, and theatrical systems, and position their brand at the forefront of the region’s pro light and sound transformation. item.description: Saudi WoodShow 2026 runs 1–3 September 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center (RICEC) as Saudi Arabia’s dedicated event for the wood and woodworking machinery sector. item.title: Hotel & Hospitality Expo
item.description: Hotel & Hospitality Expo Saudi Arabia takes place in Riyadh from 13–15 September 2026 at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center, bringing together leading local and international brands with some of the Kingdom’s most influential buyers across the hotel and hospitality sector. As Saudi Arabia’s tourism and travel growth accelerates in line with Vision 2030, the expo offers a prime platform to build partnerships, discover the latest trends and technologies, and connect with global exhibitors and designers. Visitors can explore a comprehensive range of solutions covering hospitality interiors, operating supplies and equipment, HoReCa and food services, cleaning and hygiene, hospitality technology, hotel services, and wellness (gyms, recreation, spa, and sports). Inquire Now

item.title: Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
item.description: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.
